Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side to help you prepare: 

- SOC 2: Oakridge requires a completed Type 2 for platforms that will process PHI in production. That said, for vendors moving through procurement we accept an in-progress Type 2 with a clear completion date plus control evidence. Please provide expected completion quarter and any interim artifacts (SOC bridge letter, Type 1).
- GDPR: most of our data remains US-resident for this project; GDPR questions are limited but we will need DPAs and details on subprocessors.
- HIPAA: yes — a signed BAA will be required before production onboarding. Our legal / procurement lead is Mayank Rao (mayank.rao@oakridgehealth.com).
- Incident response / breach notification: Oakridge policy is to notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirming a reportable breach. For initial vendor screening we typically request:
  * IR playbook or executive summary showing detection, containment, and escalation steps
  * Typical RTO/RPO targets for critical services
  * A short timeline example of a prior (redacted) notification flow or a template notice

We prefer to receive questionnaires via a secure link (DocuSign or SFTP) rather than editable attachments. If you can post the vendor QS to a secure drive link and share it, that would be ideal.

Proposed time: Tue 11/4 10:00–10:30 PST works for a short security intro. I’ll invite Mayank and our InfoSec manager.

Regards,
Carly Moss
Director, Information Security
Oakridge Health
---
Note: Oakridge will expect BAA language early in contracting.
